```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source(file = "./utils/exp2-utils.R") # loads all necessary packages
```

```{r data load}
dataPath <- "data/exp2/"
mg_pilot_df <- read_csv(paste(dataPath, "pilot-mg.csv", sep = ""), show_col_types = FALSE)
us_pilot_df <- read_csv(paste(dataPath, "pilot-us.csv", sep = ""), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r filtered out partial data}
manual_keep_ids <- c("09b12105-8844-4979-b829-450cea06e9ee")

mg_pilot_df_finished <- mg_pilot_df %>%
  mutate(
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "undefined"),
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "null"),
    percentComplete = as.numeric(percentComplete)) %>%
  group_by(participantId) %>%
  filter(
    (any(!is.na(percentComplete)) &&
      max(percentComplete, na.rm = TRUE) == 100
    ) || any(participantId %in% manual_keep_ids)) %>%
  ungroup()

us_pilot_df_finished <- us_pilot_df %>%
  mutate(
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "undefined"),
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "null"),
    percentComplete = as.numeric(percentComplete)) %>%
  group_by(participantId) %>%
  filter(
    any(!is.na(percentComplete)) &&
    max(percentComplete, na.rm = TRUE) == 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
# ID, Concept A, Concept B, Answer, Response Time, Category(MG_US_level), Color_left, Color_right, left_height, right_height
mg_ppt_response_df <- mg_pilot_df_finished %>%
  filter(
    responseId == "choice",
    str_detect(trialId, "^p[^_]*_s[^_]*_t[^_]*$")) %>%
  select(participantId, trialId, answer)

mg_ppt_clean_data <- mg_ppt_response_df %>%
  mutate(parsed = map(answer, fromJSON)) %>%
  transmute(
    participantId,
    trialId,
    answer,
    conceptA = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptA$text),
    conceptA_color = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptA$chosenColorCode),
    conceptB = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptB$text),
    conceptB_color = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptB$chosenColorCode),
    responseTime = map_dbl(parsed, ~ as.numeric(.x$responseTime)),
    mgLevel = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$mgLevel),
    usLevel = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$usLevel),
    leftColorCode = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$leftColorCode),
    rightColorCode = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$rightColorCode),
    leftHeight = map_dbl(parsed, ~ as.numeric(.x$leftHeight)),
    rightHeight = map_dbl(parsed, ~ as.numeric(.x$rightHeight)))

us_ppt_response_df <- us_pilot_df_finished %>%
  filter(
    responseId == "choice",
    str_detect(trialId, "^p[^_]*_s[^_]*_t[^_]*$")) %>%
  select(participantId, trialId, answer)

us_ppt_clean_data <- us_ppt_response_df %>%
  mutate(parsed = map(answer, fromJSON)) %>%
  transmute(
    participantId,
    trialId,
    answer,
    conceptA = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptA$text),
    conceptA_color = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptA$chosenColorCode),
    conceptB = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptB$text),
    conceptB_color = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$conceptB$chosenColorCode),
    responseTime = map_dbl(parsed, ~ as.numeric(.x$responseTime)),
    mgLevel = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$mgLevel),
    usLevel = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$usLevel),
    leftColorCode = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$leftColorCode),
    rightColorCode = map_chr(parsed, ~ .x$rightColorCode),
    leftHeight = map_dbl(parsed, ~ as.numeric(.x$leftHeight)),
    rightHeight = map_dbl(parsed, ~ as.numeric(.x$rightHeight)))
```

```{r save data}
write.csv(mg_ppt_clean_data, "data/exp2/pilot-mg-clean.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
write.csv(us_ppt_clean_data, "data/exp2/pilot-us-clean.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
